task: Hardening pass + ARIA app tools: safe decode-then-apply backup restore, scratch-context action execution (no global rollback), destructive-action confirmation, expanded ARIA tool catalog covering every data type (grades, predicted grades, mastery, flashcards, subjects, profile, memory, unit state, plans), API-key header transport, HTTPS-only provider URLs, at-rest backup exclusion, curriculum memoization, and cleanup of dead code and force unwraps.

nodes.summary: Native macOS Study menu and command payloads.
Receives app command notifications and routes navigation/refresh actions.
Deterministic XP threshold lookup, clamped progress, guarded XP mutation.
Due-card snapshot refresh and subject-indexed scope filtering.
Pure priority scoring for due/overdue/mastery/exam urgency.
Scheduler consumes grouped scopes and cached per-subject card lists.
Menu command routing payload regression tests.
Rank threshold/progress/mutation regression tests.
Review priority policy regression tests.
Queue snapshot and fallback regression tests.
Mac-only SDK, supported platforms, shared scheme, deployment target, app metadata, and release versioning.
AppKit-only colors and NSHapticFeedbackManager feedback for native macOS behavior.
Code block copy action uses NSPasteboard directly.
Top menu exposes Study, Assistant, Insights, Account, and standard Settings commands with Mac keyboard shortcuts.
Regression coverage that every menu navigation command maps to its sidebar destination.
Reusable configured URLSession, request body encoding, retries, streaming error handling, and response parsing.
Batched streamed-token UI updates to reduce main-actor churn while preserving final streamed text.
Fetch limits and bounded context construction for chat history and app state snapshots.
Avoid redundant studied-scope grouping work during due-card filtering and counts.
Existing macOS test suite plus targeted service tests for transport/body/history behavior.
Root project README accurately presents native macOS app scope, architecture, setup, test commands, and repo workflow.
App-level README gives focused developer notes for the IBVault target, services, data model, and QA commands.
Repository ignore rules cover common macOS/Xcode local artifacts without hiding source files.
RPG plan, file index, and run artifacts reflect the final cleanup pass without stale deleted run logs.
Final JSON validation and macOS test command evidence for the wrap-up run.
Restore decodes and validates every file before clearing live data; duplicate subjects collapse instead of trapping.
App actions execute in a derived scratch context; failures never roll back the app-wide shared context.
ARIA tool catalog makes every data type malleable: grades, predicted grades, mastery, flashcards, subjects, profile, memory, unit state, plans, with destructive-action confirmation.
Gemini API key sent via x-goog-api-key header, not the URL query string.
Custom provider base URLs require HTTPS unless loopback; error bodies truncated before surfacing.
Per-subject curriculum trees memoized; node sync only rewrites rows whose metadata changed.
Regression tests: corrupt backup aborts without clearing live data; valid backup restores atomically.
102 end-to-end scenarios driving ARIA tool JSON through the real parse+execute pipeline with data-mutation assertions.
applyAppToolPlan exposes the post-planning pipeline for model-output-driven E2E testing.
Curated per-subject knowledge (key concepts, high-yield topics, misconceptions, exam technique, command terms) injected into ARIA prompts and subject detail.
Catalog completeness and prompt-block validation.
Crash fixes (chat delete while streaming, completion snapshot, compaction scratch context), duplicate/empty/stale UI states, x-axis and clock bugs, and O(n) view recomputation fixes.
New regression suites: ReviewScheduler ordering, StudyPlan formatters, JSON line buffer, subject knowledge, streak-freeze/consent-gate angles, Gemini header transport.

Final UI pass: cached prediction/subject/mastery computations, no per-render O(n) scans, removed inert swipe actions and silent save failures, lazy backup/keychain scanning, conservative recovery banner.

Three new self-authored courses: Advanced Mathematics (proofs & foundations), Fundamentals of the Universe, Startups & Venture Capital (VC expectations + financial tools), non-overlapping with IB Business Management.
ARIA gains per-subject domain knowledge for all 9 subjects, including a distilled VC playbook (fund economics, term sheets, unit economics, runway).
Course curricula exist, deep subunit coverage, and Startups course does not overlap Business Management.
SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES on both targets; zero-warning build enforced.
English B paper labels corrected (Paper 1 productive / Paper 2 receptive+listening), Biology homeostasis added, spelling/year-consistency, 3 new courses structurally audited.
Swift 6 language mode (strict concurrency + Sendable enforcement) with SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS.
AppActionType enum: 25 tools + .unknown, exhaustive executor dispatch, typed destructive gate.
ChatMessageRole is now an indirect enum (user/model/failure/cancelled/dismissed) that round-trips through the stored string.
